title: Mechanical Assembly and Integration Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Mechanical Assembly & Integration Engineer with 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in robotics, industrial automation, SPM, machine assembly, and system integration . 
 The candidate will be responsible for mechanical assembly, integration, alignment, rework, debugging, and commissioning of robotic automation equipment, machines, jigs, fixtures, conveyors, and associated mechanical systems . 
 Key Responsibilities Mechanical Assembly & Integration Assemble and integrate robotic automation machines, SPMs, fixtures, conveyors, guarding, and mechanical sub-assemblies. Interpret mechanical drawings, assembly drawings, BOMs, and fabrication drawings. Ensure correct assembly sequence, fitment, alignment, and fastening. Robotics Integration Support mechanical integration of industrial robots, robot bases, linear tracks, positioners, grippers, EOAT, conveyors, and peripheral equipment . Assist in robot-cell installation and mechanical commissioning. Coordinate with robot programmers, PLC engineers, and electrical teams during integration. Jigs & Fixtures Assembly and installation of jigs, fixtures, welding fixtures, locating systems, clamps, grippers, and tooling . Check fixture alignment, repeatability, clamping, locating, and accessibility. Support fixture trials and modifications based on production requirements. Rework & Modification Identify assembly and integration issues and carry out necessary mechanical rework and modifications . Perform drilling, tapping, slotting, shimming, alignment, grinding, and other shop-floor correction activities as required. Implement design changes and modifications during machine build and commissioning. Alignment & Commissioning Perform alignment of shafts, bearings, linear guides, conveyors, fixtures, robots, and mechanical assemblies. Check machine movement, interference, clearances, and mechanical functionality. Support machine trials, FAT, SAT, and customer-site commissioning. Troubleshooting Identify and resolve mechanical issues such as vibration, misalignment, interference, excessive play, improper movement, and component failure. Work with design and engineering teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions. Documentation & Quality Follow assembly drawings, checklists, quality requirements, and project procedures. Record assembly issues, modifications, rework, and punch points. Ensure completed assemblies meet drawing and project specifications. 
 Required Skills Mechanical Assembly & Machine Integration Industrial Robotics & Automation SPM / Machine Building Jigs & Fixtures Mechanical Alignment Rework & Modification Engineering Drawing Reading Machine Elements Pneumatic Components Conveyors & Material Handling Systems Robot Peripheral Integration Hand Tools & Workshop Practices Basic measurement instruments Vernier, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Dial Gauge, etc. Basic understanding of tolerances, fits and GD&T 
 Preferred Industry Experience Candidates with experience in: Robotics & Automation | SPM | Industrial Automation | Machine Building | Automotive Automation | Welding Automation | Assembly Automation | Jigs & Fixtures | Material Handling will be preferred. 
 Candidate Profile Experience working with robotic automation equipment and industrial machinery preferred. Should be comfortable working on the shop floor and at customer sites. Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with cross-functional Design, Robotics, PLC, Electrical, Production and Project teams . Willingness to travel for installation and commissioning. 
 Key Requirement This is a hands-on mechanical integration role. Candidates should have practical experience in machine assembly, robotics/automation integration, jigs & fixtures, alignment, rework, modification, and commissioning.

Key Skills: Assembly Process,Jigs& Fixtures,Motor Assembly,Power Tools,Assembly Planning,Gear Box,Industrial Robots,Assembly Line

title: Campaign Engineer
description:
Join our India Tech Hub - Be among the first hires! 
 Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty. 
 ABOUT THE TEAM AND WHAT WE LL BUILD TOGETHER The Marketing Operations team is Kobie s campaign execution engine - delivering outbound loyalty communications for some of the world s most recognized brands. Organized into three pillars (Campaign Management, Development, and Quality Assurance), the team builds and deploys high-volume, personalized email campaigns that reach millions of loyalty members. As a Marketing Ops Developer, you ll sit at the heart of that delivery - owning the HTML and journey development that brings each campaign to life. You ll work closely with Campaign Managers, QA Analysts, and client teams to ensure every send is accurate, on-brand, and on time. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT As a Campaign Engineer, you own the technical execution of campaigns from build through deployment. You ll work across two core areas: HTML Email Development Develop and maintain HTML/CSS email templates - ensuring accurate rendering across devices, email clients, and platforms Build reusable modular components and adapt client-specific templates to campaign requirements Test email rendering across clients and devices using tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid Journey Campaign Development Build and deploy outbound campaigns (primarily email) in Kobie-hosted platforms and client campaign management systems including Salesforce Marketing Cloud Configure journey logic, audience segmentation, targeting rules, and suppression lists per campaign specifications Implement dynamic content, personalization tokens, and promotional offer logic according to strategy requirements Own the final deployment step for all assigned campaigns - ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery Execution Collaboration Execute A/B and multivariate (MVT) test configurations according to defined test plans Coordinate asset handoffs with Campaign Managers and content partners; flag dependency gaps proactively Document execution best practices and maintain build standards within the Development pillar Follow platform tooling standards and governance guidelines established by Campaign Management At the end of the first year, success means: campaigns build accurately and on schedule, builds consistently pass QA with minimal rework, and platform standards and SOPs are followed without prompting WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience: 1-3 years of experience in email development, marketing operations, or digital campaign execution Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS for email, including cross-client rendering Experience with at least one enterprise campaign platform - Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred Foundational understanding of journey orchestration - able to build single and multi-step automated flows, triggered sends, and entry/exit criteria within a campaign platform Familiarity with campaign automation concepts: event-based triggers, lifecycle programs, re-engagement flows, and scheduled vs. triggered deployment Understanding of A/B and MVT testing mechanics - able to configure test variants, split audiences, and execute test sends according to a defined test plan Understanding of audience segmentation, targeting logic, and data-driven personalization Strong attention to detail; proactive about catching discrepancies before campaigns go to QA Clear communicator - able to flag issues and ask the right questions before builds begin Bachelor s degree or equivalent experience Additional Skills That Will Help You Stand Out: Experience with Litmus, Email on Acid, or equivalent rendering test tools Familiarity with AMPScript, SQL, or other scripting/query languages used in campaign platforms Experience with additional ESPs such as Adobe Campaign, Braze, Iterable, or Marketo Knowledge of dynamic content and conditional content logic within campaign platforms Exposure to multi-channel or cross-channel campaign orchestration (email + SMS, push, or direct mail) Experience using project/workflow management tools such as Workfront or Jira HOW YOUR SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED Understanding of the client s operations Documentation of processes and procedures Oversight of marketing operations end-to-end About Kobie 
 Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. 
 As a trusted partner to some of the world s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special. 
 We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard. Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities. 
 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance. 
 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection. Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Specialist
description:
Cyber - Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Specialist: Job Specification: Maersk is a $30bn organisation with 100, 000 people that move 20% of the world s trade, and the largest shipping and logistics company in the world and we are transforming our company into a global integrator of container logistics. We are offering you a unique opportunity to help shape that journey and the future organization. As a part of this process, you will have an opportunity to participate in a global IT transformation program that will set the direction of the future business model for this large global organization. What We offer: As an organization with a global presence, joining Maersk is a wonderful and exciting opportunity for you to work with people of diverse talents backgrounds. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and truly international atmosphere with activities spread around the globe in Copenhagen, London, Charlotte, and India. The environment is dynamic with a focus on high performance, results, and respect for our employees. There will be the possibility of continuous professional and personal development and for gaining a professional and social network. As a company, we are committed to growing our people. We will provide you with opportunities that broaden your knowledge and strengthen your professional technical skills. As a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Specialist, you will be part of a team responsible for rolling out and integrating various solutions into our IT Landscape. You will work independently and with development teams/stakeholders in various locations, e. g. Copenhagen and the UK. Key responsibilities: The Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Specialist is responsible for driving the function towards successful technical delivery, utilising various programmes and operational support to increase capability and reduce risk. Managing technical debt and technology trade-offs, communicating those to the Service Owner ensuring implementation quality and that correct procedures are in place to assure code and feature quality. Working closely with other interdependent Engineering Managers to produce required design specifications and ensure operational solutions work together and fulfil business needs. Working with organisational resources outside the team to remove impediments and protect them from organisational bureaucracy. As a Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Specialist, you will report directly to the Senior Manager of Cryptography Directory Services with the following tasks: Continuous service improvement: PKI is heavily used within Maersk, and you will strive to improve its performance and health daily. Performing daily service checks and fulfilling request tickets for DNS PKI. Responding to Incidents and Major Incidents in a timely manner to drive resolution Driving automation in certificate and key lifecycle management across Maersk The ability to extract data, generate reports which highlight where service improvements are required, and create opportunities for development and risk reduction. Develop or ensure documentation / code is at high standard and specification in accordance with current framework, working with the wider team and vendors to deliver. Build strong collaborative relationships with architects, designers, engineers, external agencies, vendor staff and partners. Build strong collaborative external relationships with industry experts. Develop scope definition, technical viability scoping and best practice solution design to meet the requirements Provide guidance to the Solution Architect in the development of solutions. Highlight all risks and issues that affect the development or deliveries Form strong and trusted relationship with the Product Owner; ensuring that the Product Owner is fully aware of the technical capabilities and shortcomings of the product allowing for sensible technical investment and debt repayment decisions Work across teams to define efficient solutions and implementation strategies to create highly cohesive implementation across products Share best technical practice across the team and develop others in their technical learning. Demonstrate interest in improving the company s technical awareness, depth and use of technology across the business. Participate in the evolution of company level best practices, standards, and policies related to software development. We are looking for: Experience Technical Skills: A minimum of 6+ years working with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Access Management and Identity in general Experience with Venafi and/or similar Certificate Lifecycle Management suite Experience in Key Management System (Entrust Key Control) Knowledge of Microsoft s Active Directory Certificate Services, implementation and its security. Experience Managing configuring Hardware Security Module (HSM) technology (Thales/Entrust) Experience with managing Public Domain Names External DNS Records. Good experience in system integration using modern technologies e. g. REST API, MS Graph API and Log Analytics API Automation is key! You will have experience working with PKI to optimise and automate Highly skilled in writing clean, reusable and efficient script that is easy to read Deep knowledge and understanding of technology; a person who stays relevant with the latest technology advancements and trends Knowledge of Identity Access management solutions and protocols. Knowledgeable in cloud-based document management products. Advantage if: Knowledge of DevOps or something similar Knowledge of ITIL v3 Knowledge of auditing Ways of working: You are passionate about PKI, authentication, authorisation and security related to identity. You keep up with new developments within the identity world. Understand the principles of least privileges. We never give out more permissions than required! Understand that if something looks or feels wrong, then it probably is wrong! Willing to take ownership of a problem, even if no one is else is willing to do so. Highly motivated and work well under pressure Willing to keep up and learn new technology and understand how they will be beneficial to Maersk if implemented. Be concise and to the point. Have excellent communication skills. You will need to explain complex solutions to other engineers, end users, developers and management and can change the level of technical language used dependent on the target audience. You can articulate the risk of implementing or nor implementing a solution. Have excellent documentation skills. This could be when you are creating documentation for other engineers within Confluence, creating LLD s / HLD s, creating end user documentation or producing a read me file within source control. Structured, highly analytical mindset and excellent problem-solving skills. You will need to understand complex identity and attribute flows and be able to come to root cause very quickly. Collaborative, with strong facilitation and people skills / personal impact Willing to work on new technologies and languages outside of their core skillset Innovative, with the ability to think outside the box Fact-based and result oriented An individual who respects the opinion of others; yet can drive a decision through the team An individual who understands and respects the agile method An individual who wants to contribute to the wider engineering community to define best practices Leader of people: The ability to leads reviews of others designs and software implementations The ability to engage the team to achieve goals. The ability to inspire fellow technical people Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking.
